summary.text: Mari Watanabe is a Democratic state representative from District 34 who has held the seat since January 2025 and is seeking election on November 3, 2026.
The Multnomah and Washington county boards of commissioners appointed her on January 15, 2025, to replace Lisa Reynolds.

paragraphs.text: Before her appointment, Mari Watanabe was executive director of Partners in Diversity in Portland, Oregon, from 2010 to 2023.
She was named the first executive director of the Japanese American Museum of Oregon in 2008.
Ballotpedia reports she is the first female Japanese American to serve in the Oregon House of Representatives.
